name: Future Bright Holdings Limited
summary: Future Bright Holdings Limited, founded in 2001 and based in Sheung Wan, Hong Kong, is an investment holding company active in food and beverage across Hong Kong, Macau, mainland China and Taiwan. It reports three segments: food and catering, food souvenirs, and property investment. Its activities range from selling festive and specialty foods to running restaurants, coffee outlets and food processing facilities, alongside property leasing and food trading.
